name: Juvenile Raptor Swiftwing
description: Only recently discovered on the island of Castora, the swiftwing raptor is covered in a thick layer of jewel-toned feathers that blend in with the island's vivid vegetation. Researchers have noted its ear-shattering shriek and razor-edged talons, urging members of the Tyrian Alliance to approach the saurian with caution. —Acht
